stemMd: A roof rises at an angle of 30° above a horizontal span of 6 m. What vertical rise corresponds to that span?
explanationMd: The horizontal span is adjacent to the angle and rise opposite. Rise=6 tan30=6/√3=2√3 metres.

distractorRationale.a: This uses cosine rather than tangent.
distractorRationale.e: This would correspond to a forty-five-degree slope.
distractorRationale.b: This exceeds the rise implied by the given shallow angle.
distractorRationale.c: This uses sine with the horizontal span instead of tangent.
